description: Start a durable analysis across the session sources. exhaustive processes every eligible interview; quick retrieves verified evidence through File Search; aggregate computes exact counts; explore runs bounded computation. Poll get_research_analysis. Prefer chat_research_session or queue_research_chat for questions and generate_research_output for saved outputs. Completed or partial runs can produce presentations, clips or reels; retain coverage and limitations. Reuse the idempotency key on uncertain retries.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.
